#!/bin/bash
set -euo pipefail

SCRIPT_DIR="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")" && pwd)"

# ── Ensure Node/npm/npx are on PATH even in non-interactive shells ───────────
# Several providers below shell out to `npx @github/copilot@...`/`npx
# @anthropic-ai/claude-code` etc. when the CLI binary itself isn't globally
# installed. Node is typically managed by nvm, and nvm only auto-loads via
# ~/.bashrc — but ~/.bashrc's very first lines ("If not running
# interactively, don't do anything") make it a no-op for any NON-interactive
# shell, including `bash -lc "..."` (which is exactly how dmtools/Java spawns
# this script via ProcessBuilder, and how run-teammate-local.sh/CI invoke it
# too). Without this, every `npx ...` call fails outright with
# "npx: command not found" (exit 127) — but the surrounding Teammate job
# still reports success and its postJSAction still advances the ticket
# (labels + status change), producing a "completed" run that silently wrote
# NO content at all (see e.g. agents/js/assignForSolutionArchitecture.js).
# Guarded on `command -v npx` so this is a fast no-op once Node is already
# resolvable (global install, PATH already exporting nvm's bin dir, etc).
if ! command -v npx >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  export NVM_DIR="${NVM_DIR:-$HOME/.nvm}"
  if [ -s "${NVM_DIR}/nvm.sh" ]; then
    # shellcheck source=/dev/null
    \. "${NVM_DIR}/nvm.sh" --no-use
    nvm use default >/dev/null 2>&1 || nvm use node >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
  fi
fi

# Load shared helpers and provider implementations.
# shellcheck source=/dev/null
source "${SCRIPT_DIR}/providers/_common.sh"
# shellcheck source=/dev/null
source "${SCRIPT_DIR}/providers/claude.sh"
# shellcheck source=/dev/null
source "${SCRIPT_DIR}/providers/codemie.sh"
# shellcheck source=/dev/null
source "${SCRIPT_DIR}/providers/copilot.sh"
# shellcheck source=/dev/null
source "${SCRIPT_DIR}/providers/fa.sh"
# shellcheck source=/dev/null
source "${SCRIPT_DIR}/providers/kimi.sh"
# shellcheck source=/dev/null
source "${SCRIPT_DIR}/providers/cursor.sh"

usage() {
  cat <<EOF
Usage: $(basename "$0") "prompt"

Runs the configured AI agent with the provided prompt.
Provider is controlled by AI_AGENT_PROVIDER environment variable (default: cursor).

Providers:
  cursor       - Uses cursor-agent (default)
  claude-code  - Uses Claude Code CLI via Bedrock proxy (ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL + ANTHROPIC_API_KEY)
  codemie      - Uses codemie-claude
  copilot      - Uses GitHub Copilot CLI (npx @github/copilot)
  fa           - Uses the Fa CLI (fa); requires FA_PROVIDER_TYPE +
                 FA_PROVIDER_MODEL, optional FA_PROVIDER_BASE_URL and
                 FA_PROVIDER_API_KEY
  kimi         - Uses Kimi Code CLI (kimi)

Example:
  $(basename "$0") "process the input folder"

Notes:
  - Provide the prompt as a single argument
  - Extra arguments before the prompt are passed through to the agent (cursor and codemie)
  - Useful for resume: $(basename "$0") --continue "fix the push error"
    (do NOT combine with --resume: Copilot CLI rejects --continue + --resume together)
  - For codemie: requires CODEMIE_API_KEY and CODEMIE_BASE_URL environment variables
  - For copilot: requires COPILOT_GITHUB_TOKEN or GITHUB_TOKEN environment variable
  - For cursor: optional CURSOR_MODEL env var (default: auto)
  - For kimi: requires KIMI_API_KEY environment variable unless authenticated via OAuth;
              optional KIMI_BASE_URL and KIMI_MODEL
  - Final response is written to outputs/response.md
EOF
}

if [ $# -lt 1 ]; then
_common.sh
claude.sh
claude_usage.py
codemie.sh
copilot.sh
copilot_usage.py
cursor.sh

Classification regexes:

arguments.content:
# quota park probe

Bounded self-lift for the gh-1087 provider-quota park: runs locally on every SM tick against tickets carrying the park label (default `provider_quota`) and fires one cheap provider ping only when the recorded probe count hits the `jobParams.quotaProbeEveryNTicks` cadence (default 3 ticks).

Probe success means the quota window has reset or the provider was reconfigured — the handler removes the park label, clears the development/rework dispatch trigger labels, moves the ticket back to Ready For Development and posts an un-park comment, so the normal dispatch lanes resume on the next tick. Probe failure keeps the park and posts a one-line `quota-probe: <n>` marker comment that doubles as the durable counter for the next tick's cadence decision.

## Parameters

- `jobParams.quotaParkLabel` — park label name to watch and remove (default `provider_quota`). When overridden, the SM rule's JQL (`labels = provider_quota`) must be overridden to match.
- `jobParams.quotaProbeEveryNTicks` — probe cadence in SM ticks (default 3). The first tick after the park always probes (a misclassification self-corrects immediately).
- `jobParams.quotaProbeCommand` — the cheap provider ping shell command (default: a 1-token chat completion against the fa provider config `FA_PROVIDER_BASE_URL` / `FA_PROVIDER_API_KEY` / `FA_PROVIDER_MODEL`; curl `--fail` keeps the park on any HTTP error). Override for non-fa provider shapes.

A human un-parks immediately by removing the park label from the ticket — the probe rule stops matching and no further probes fire.

{"content":"# quota park probe

Bounded self-lift for the gh-1087 provider-quota park: runs locally on every SM tick against tickets carrying the park label (default `provider_quota`) and fires one cheap provider ping only when the recorded probe count hits the `jobParams.quotaProbeEveryNTicks` cadence (default 3 ticks).

Probe success means the quota window has reset or the provider was reconfigured — the handler removes the park label, clears the development/rework dispatch trigger labels, moves the ticket back to Ready For Development and posts an un-park comment, so the normal dispatch lanes resume on the next tick. Probe failure keeps the park and posts a one-line `quota-probe: <n>` marker comment that doubles as the durable counter for the next tick's cadence decision.

## Parameters

- `jobParams.quotaParkLabel` — park label name to watch and remove (default `provider_quota`). When overridden, the SM rule's JQL (`labels = provider_quota`) must be overridden to match.
- `jobParams.quotaProbeEveryNTicks` — probe cadence in SM ticks (default 3). The first tick after the park always probes (a misclassification self-corrects immediately).
- `jobParams.quotaProbeCommand` — the cheap provider ping shell command (default: a 1-token chat completion against the fa provider config `FA_PROVIDER_BASE_URL` / `FA_PROVIDER_API_KEY` / `FA_PROVIDER_MODEL`; curl `--fail` keeps the park on any HTTP error). Override for non-fa provider shapes.

A human un-parks immediately by removing the park label from the ticket — the probe rule stops matching and no further probes fire.

{"content":"# quota park probe

Bounded self-lift for the gh-1087 provider-quota park: runs locally on every SM tick against tickets carrying the park label (default `provider_quota`) and fires one cheap provider ping only when the recorded probe count hits the `jobParams.quotaProbeEveryNTicks` cadence (default 3 ticks).

Probe success means the quota window has reset or the provider was reconfigured — the handler removes the park label, clears the development/rework dispatch trigger labels, moves the ticket back to Ready For Development and posts an un-park comment, so the normal dispatch lanes resume on the next tick. Probe failure keeps the park and posts a one-line `quota-probe: <n>` marker comment that doubles as the durable counter for the next tick's cadence decision.

## Parameters

- `jobParams.quotaParkLabel` — park label name to watch and remove (default `provider_quota`). When overridden, the SM rule's JQL (`labels = provider_quota`) must be overridden to match.
- `jobParams.quotaProbeEveryNTicks` — probe cadence in SM ticks (default 3). The first tick after the park always probes (a misclassification self-corrects immediately).
- `jobParams.quotaProbeCommand` — the cheap provider ping shell command (default: a 1-token chat completion against the fa provider config `FA_PROVIDER_BASE_URL` / `FA_PROVIDER_API_KEY` / `FA_PROVIDER_MODEL`; curl `--fail` keeps the park on any HTTP error). Override for non-fa provider shapes.

A human un-parks immediately by removing the park label from the ticket — the probe rule stops matching and no further probes fire.

{"content":"# quota park probe

Bounded self-lift for the gh-1087 provider-quota park: runs locally on every SM tick against tickets carrying the park label (default `provider_quota`) and fires one cheap provider ping only when the recorded probe count hits the `jobParams.quotaProbeEveryNTicks` cadence (default 3 ticks).

Probe success means the quota window has reset or the provider was reconfigured — the handler removes the park label, clears the development/rework dispatch trigger labels, moves the ticket back to Ready For Development and posts an un-park comment, so the normal dispatch lanes resume on the next tick. Probe failure keeps the park and posts a one-line `quota-probe: <n>` marker comment that doubles as the durable counter for the next tick's cadence decision.

## Parameters

- `jobParams.quotaParkLabel` — park label name to watch and remove (default `provider_quota`). When overridden, the SM rule's JQL (`labels = provider_quota`) must be overridden to match.
- `jobParams.quotaProbeEveryNTicks` — probe cadence in SM ticks (default 3). The first tick after the park always probes (a misclassification self-corrects immediately).
- `jobParams.quotaProbeCommand` — the cheap provider ping shell command (default: a 1-token chat completion against the fa provider config `FA_PROVIDER_BASE_URL` / `FA_PROVIDER_API_KEY` / `FA_PROVIDER_MODEL`; curl `--fail` keeps the park on any HTTP error). Override for non-fa provider shapes.

A human un-parks immediately by removing the park label from the ticket — the probe rule stops matching and no further probes fire.

{"content":"# quota park probe

Bounded self-lift for the gh-1087 provider-quota park: runs locally on every SM tick against tickets carrying the park label (default `provider_quota`) and fires one cheap provider ping only when the recorded probe count hits the `jobParams.quotaProbeEveryNTicks` cadence (default 3 ticks).

Probe success means the quota window has reset or the provider was reconfigured — the handler removes the park label, clears the development/rework dispatch trigger labels, moves the ticket back to Ready For Development and posts an un-park comment, so the normal dispatch lanes resume on the next tick. Probe failure keeps the park and posts a one-line `quota-probe: <n>` marker comment that doubles as the durable counter for the next tick's cadence decision.

## Parameters

- `jobParams.quotaParkLabel` — park label name to watch and remove (default `provider_quota`). When overridden, the SM rule's JQL (`labels = provider_quota`) must be overridden to match.
- `jobParams.quotaProbeEveryNTicks` — probe cadence in SM ticks (default 3). The first tick after the park always probes (a misclassification self-corrects immediately).
- `jobParams.quotaProbeCommand` — the cheap provider ping shell command (default: a 1-token chat completion against the fa provider config `FA_PROVIDER_BASE_URL` / `FA_PROVIDER_API_KEY` / `FA_PROVIDER_MODEL`; curl `--fail` keeps the park on any HTTP error). Override for non-fa provider shapes.

A human un-parks immediately by removing the park label from the ticket — the probe rule stops matching and no further probes fire.

{"content":"# quota park probe

Bounded self-lift for the gh-1087 provider-quota park: runs locally on every SM tick against tickets carrying the park label (default `provider_quota`) and fires one cheap provider ping only when the recorded probe count hits the `jobParams.quotaProbeEveryNTicks` cadence (default 3 ticks).

Probe success means the quota window has reset or the provider was reconfigured — the handler removes the park label, clears the development/rework dispatch trigger labels, moves the ticket back to Ready For Development and posts an un-park comment, so the normal dispatch lanes resume on the next tick. Probe failure keeps the park and posts a one-line `quota-probe: <n>` marker comment that doubles as the durable counter for the next tick's cadence decision.

## Parameters

- `jobParams.quotaParkLabel` — park label name to watch and remove (default `provider_quota`). When overridden, the SM rule's JQL (`labels = provider_quota`) must be overridden to match.
- `jobParams.quotaProbeEveryNTicks` — probe cadence in SM ticks (default 3). The first tick after the park always probes (a misclassification self-corrects immediately).
- `jobParams.quotaProbeCommand` — the cheap provider ping shell command (default: a 1-token chat completion against the fa provider config `FA_PROVIDER_BASE_URL` / `FA_PROVIDER_API_KEY` / `FA_PROVIDER_MODEL`; curl `--fail` keeps the park on any HTTP error). Override for non-fa provider shapes.

A human un-parks immediately by removing the park label from the ticket — the probe rule stops matching and no further probes fire.

{"content":"# quota park probe

Bounded self-lift for the gh-1087 provider-quota park: runs locally on every SM tick against tickets carrying the park label (default `provider_quota`) and fires one cheap provider ping only when the recorded probe count hits the `jobParams.quotaProbeEveryNTicks` cadence (default 3 ticks).

Probe success means the quota window has reset or the provider was reconfigured — the handler removes the park label, clears the development/rework dispatch trigger labels, moves the ticket back to Ready For Development and posts an un-park comment, so the normal dispatch lanes resume on the next tick. Probe failure keeps the park and posts a one-line `quota-probe: <n>` marker comment that doubles as the durable counter for the next tick's cadence decision.

## Parameters

- `jobParams.quotaParkLabel` — park label name to watch and remove (default `provider_quota`). When overridden, the SM rule's JQL (`labels = provider_quota`) must be overridden to match.
- `jobParams.quotaProbeEveryNTicks` — probe cadence in SM ticks (default 3). The first tick after the park always probes (a misclassification self-corrects immediately).
- `jobParams.quotaProbeCommand` — the cheap provider ping shell command (default: a 1-token chat completion against the fa provider config `FA_PROVIDER_BASE_URL` / `FA_PROVIDER_API_KEY` / `FA_PROVIDER_MODEL`; curl `--fail` keeps the park on any HTTP error). Override for non-fa provider shapes.

A human un-parks immediately by removing the park label from the ticket — the probe rule stops matching and no further probes fire.

{"content":"# quota park probe

Bounded self-lift for the gh-1087 provider-quota park: runs locally on every SM tick against tickets carrying the park label (default `provider_quota`) and fires one cheap provider ping only when the recorded probe count hits the `jobParams.quotaProbeEveryNTicks` cadence (default 3 ticks).

Probe success means the quota window has reset or the provider was reconfigured — the handler removes the park label, clears the development/rework dispatch trigger labels, moves the ticket back to Ready For Development and posts an un-park comment, so the normal dispatch lanes resume on the next tick. Probe failure keeps the park and posts a one-line `quota-probe: <n>` marker comment that doubles as the durable counter for the next tick's cadence decision.

## Parameters

- `jobParams.quotaParkLabel` — park label name to watch and remove (default `provider_quota`). When overridden, the SM rule's JQL (`labels = provider_quota`) must be overridden to match.
- `jobParams.quotaProbeEveryNTicks` — probe cadence in SM ticks (default 3). The first tick after the park always probes (a misclassification self-corrects immediately).
- `jobParams.quotaProbeCommand` — the cheap provider ping shell command (default: a 1-token chat completion against the fa provider config `FA_PROVIDER_BASE_URL` / `FA_PROVIDER_API_KEY` / `FA_PROVIDER_MODEL`; curl `--fail` keeps the park on any HTTP error). Override for non-fa provider shapes.

A human un-parks immediately by removing the park label from the ticket — the probe rule stops matching and no further probes fire.

{"content":"# quota park probe

Bounded self-lift for the gh-1087 provider-quota park: runs locally on every SM tick against tickets carrying the park label (default `provider_quota`) and fires one cheap provider ping only when the recorded probe count hits the `jobParams.quotaProbeEveryNTicks` cadence (default 3 ticks).

Probe success means the quota window has reset or the provider was reconfigured — the handler removes the park label, clears the development/rework dispatch trigger labels, moves the ticket back to Ready For Development and posts an un-park comment, so the normal dispatch lanes resume on the next tick. Probe failure keeps the park and posts a one-line `quota-probe: <n>` marker comment that doubles as the durable counter for the next tick's cadence decision.

## Parameters

- `jobParams.quotaParkLabel` — park label name to watch and remove (default `provider_quota`). When overridden, the SM rule's JQL (`labels = provider_quota`) must be overridden to match.
- `jobParams.quotaProbeEveryNTicks` — probe cadence in SM ticks (default 3). The first tick after the park always probes (a misclassification self-corrects immediately).
- `jobParams.quotaProbeCommand` — the cheap provider ping shell command (default: a 1-token chat completion against the fa provider config `FA_PROVIDER_BASE_URL` / `FA_PROVIDER_API_KEY` / `FA_PROVIDER_MODEL`; curl `--fail` keeps the park on any HTTP error). Override for non-fa provider shapes.

A human un-parks immediately by removing the park label from the ticket — the probe rule stops matching and no further probes fire.

{"content":"# quota park probe

Bounded self-lift for the gh-1087 provider-quota park: runs locally on every SM tick against tickets carrying the park label (default `provider_quota`) and fires one cheap provider ping only when the recorded probe count hits the `jobParams.quotaProbeEveryNTicks` cadence (default 3 ticks).

Probe success means the quota window has reset or the provider was reconfigured — the handler removes the park label, clears the development/rework dispatch trigger labels, moves the ticket back to Ready For Development and posts an un-park comment, so the normal dispatch lanes resume on the next tick. Probe failure keeps the park and posts a one-line `quota-probe: <n>` marker comment that doubles as the durable counter for the next tick's cadence decision.

## Parameters

- `jobParams.quotaParkLabel` — park label name to watch and remove (default `provider_quota`). When overridden, the SM rule's JQL (`labels = provider_quota`) must be overridden to match.
- `jobParams.quotaProbeEveryNTicks` — probe cadence in SM ticks (default 3). The first tick after the park always probes (a misclassification self-corrects immediately).
- `jobParams.quotaProbeCommand` — the cheap provider ping shell command (default: a 1-token chat completion against the fa provider config `FA_PROVIDER_BASE_URL` / `FA_PROVIDER_API_KEY` / `FA_PROVIDER_MODEL`; curl `--fail` keeps the park on any HTTP error). Override for non-fa provider shapes.

A human un-parks immediately by removing the park label from the ticket — the probe rule stops matching and no further probes fire.

{"content":"# quota park probe

Bounded self-lift for the gh-1087 provider-quota park: runs locally on every SM tick against tickets carrying the park label (default `provider_quota`) and fires one cheap provider ping only when the recorded probe count hits the `jobParams.quotaProbeEveryNTicks` cadence (default 3 ticks).

Probe success means the quota window has reset or the provider was reconfigured — the handler removes the park label, clears the development/rework dispatch trigger labels, moves the ticket back to Ready For Development and posts an un-park comment, so the normal dispatch lanes resume on the next tick. Probe failure keeps the park and posts a one-line `quota-probe: <n>` marker comment that doubles as the durable counter for the next tick's cadence decision.

## Parameters

- `jobParams.quotaParkLabel` — park label name to watch and remove (default `provider_quota`). When overridden, the SM rule's JQL (`labels = provider_quota`) must be overridden to match.
- `jobParams.quotaProbeEveryNTicks` — probe cadence in SM ticks (default 3). The first tick after the park always probes (a misclassification self-corrects immediately).
- `jobParams.quotaProbeCommand` — the cheap provider ping shell command (default: a 1-token chat completion against the fa provider config `FA_PROVIDER_BASE_URL` / `FA_PROVIDER_API_KEY` / `FA_PROVIDER_MODEL`; curl `--fail` keeps the park on any HTTP error). Override for non-fa provider shapes.

A human un-parks immediately by removing the park label from the ticket — the probe rule stops matching and no further probes fire.

{"content":"# quota park probe

Bounded self-lift for the gh-1087 provider-quota park: runs locally on every SM tick against tickets carrying the park label (default `provider_quota`) and fires one cheap provider ping only when the recorded probe count hits the `jobParams.quotaProbeEveryNTicks` cadence (default 3 ticks).

Probe success means the quota window has reset or the provider was reconfigured — the handler removes the park label, clears the development/rework dispatch trigger labels, moves the ticket back to Ready For Development and posts an un-park comment, so the normal dispatch lanes resume on the next tick. Probe failure keeps the park and posts a one-line `quota-probe: <n>` marker comment that doubles as the durable counter for the next tick's cadence decision.

## Parameters

- `jobParams.quotaParkLabel` — park label name to watch and remove (default `provider_quota`). When overridden, the SM rule's JQL (`labels = provider_quota`) must be overridden to match.
- `jobParams.quotaProbeEveryNTicks` — probe cadence in SM ticks (default 3). The first tick after the park always probes (a misclassification self-corrects immediately).
- `jobParams.quotaProbeCommand` — the cheap provider ping shell command (default: a 1-token chat completion against the fa provider config `FA_PROVIDER_BASE_URL` / `FA_PROVIDER_API_KEY` / `FA_PROVIDER_MODEL`; curl `--fail` keeps the park on any HTTP error). Override for non-fa provider shapes.

A human un-parks immediately by removing the park label from the ticket — the probe rule stops matching and no further probes fire.

{"content":"# quota park probe

Bounded self-lift for the gh-1087 provider-quota park: runs locally on every SM tick against tickets carrying the park label (default `provider_quota`) and fires one cheap provider ping only when the recorded probe count hits the `jobParams.quotaProbeEveryNTicks` cadence (default 3 ticks).

Probe success means the quota window has reset or the provider was reconfigured — the handler removes the park label, clears the development/rework dispatch trigger labels, moves the ticket back to Ready For Development and posts an un-park comment, so the normal dispatch lanes resume on the next tick. Probe failure keeps the park and posts a one-line `quota-probe: <n>` marker comment that doubles as the durable counter for the next tick's cadence decision.

## Parameters

- `jobParams.quotaParkLabel` — park label name to watch and remove (default `provider_quota`). When overridden, the SM rule's JQL (`labels = provider_quota`) must be overridden to match.
- `jobParams.quotaProbeEveryNTicks` — probe cadence in SM ticks (default 3). The first tick after the park always probes (a misclassification self-corrects immediately).
- `jobParams.quotaProbeCommand` — the cheap provider ping shell command (default: a 1-token chat completion against the fa provider config `FA_PROVIDER_BASE_URL` / `FA_PROVIDER_API_KEY` / `FA_PROVIDER_MODEL`; curl `--fail` keeps the park on any HTTP error). Override for non-fa provider shapes.

A human un-parks immediately by removing the park label from the ticket — the probe rule stops matching and no further probes fire.

{"content":"# quota park probe

Bounded self-lift for the gh-1087 provider-quota park: runs locally on every SM tick against tickets carrying the park label (default `provider_quota`) and fires one cheap provider ping only when the recorded probe count hits the `jobParams.quotaProbeEveryNTicks` cadence (default 3 ticks).

Probe success means the quota window has reset or the provider was reconfigured — the handler removes the park label, clears the development/rework dispatch trigger labels, moves the ticket back to Ready For Development and posts an un-park comment, so the normal dispatch lanes resume on the next tick. Probe failure keeps the park and posts a one-line `quota-probe: <n>` marker comment that doubles as the durable counter for the next tick's cadence decision.

## Parameters

- `jobParams.quotaParkLabel` — park label name to watch and remove (default `provider_quota`). When overridden, the SM rule's JQL (`labels = provider_quota`) must be overridden to match.
- `jobParams.quotaProbeEveryNTicks` — probe cadence in SM ticks (default 3). The first tick after the park always probes (a misclassification self-corrects immediately).
- `jobParams.quotaProbeCommand` — the cheap provider ping shell command (default: a 1-token chat completion against the fa provider config `FA_PROVIDER_BASE_URL` / `FA_PROVIDER_API_KEY` / `FA_PROVIDER_MODEL`; curl `--fail` keeps the park on any HTTP error). Override for non-fa provider shapes.

A human un-parks immediately by removing the park label from the ticket — the probe rule stops matching and no further probes fire.

{"content":"# quota park probe

Bounded self-lift for the gh-1087 provider-quota park: runs locally on every SM tick against tickets carrying the park label (default `provider_quota`) and fires one cheap provider ping only when the recorded probe count hits the `jobParams.quotaProbeEveryNTicks` cadence (default 3 ticks).

Probe success means the quota window has reset or the provider was reconfigured — the handler removes the park label, clears the development/rework dispatch trigger labels, moves the ticket back to Ready For Development and posts an un-park comment, so the normal dispatch lanes resume on the next tick. Probe failure keeps the park and posts a one-line `quota-probe: <n>` marker comment that doubles as the durable counter for the next tick's cadence decision.

## Parameters

- `jobParams.quotaParkLabel` — park label name to watch and remove (default `provider_quota`). When overridden, the SM rule's JQL (`labels = provider_quota`) must be overridden to match.
- `jobParams.quotaProbeEveryNTicks` — probe cadence in SM ticks (default 3). The first tick after the park always probes (a misclassification self-corrects immediately).
- `jobParams.quotaProbeCommand` — the cheap provider ping shell command (default: a 1-token chat completion against the fa provider config `FA_PROVIDER_BASE_URL` / `FA_PROVIDER_API_KEY` / `FA_PROVIDER_MODEL`; curl `--fail` keeps the park on any HTTP error). Override for non-fa provider shapes.

A human un-parks immediately by removing the park label from the ticket — the probe rule stops matching and no further probes fire.

{"content":"# quota park probe

Bounded self-lift for the gh-1087 provider-quota park: runs locally on every SM tick against tickets carrying the park label (default `provider_quota`) and fires one cheap provider ping only when the recorded probe count hits the `jobParams.quotaProbeEveryNTicks` cadence (default 3 ticks).

Probe success means the quota window has reset or the provider was reconfigured — the handler removes the park label, clears the development/rework dispatch trigger labels, moves the ticket back to Ready For Development and posts an un-park comment, so the normal dispatch lanes resume on the next tick. Probe failure keeps the park and posts a one-line `quota-probe: <n>` marker comment that doubles as the durable counter for the next tick's cadence decision.

## Parameters

- `jobParams.quotaParkLabel` — park label name to watch and remove (default `provider_quota`). When overridden, the SM rule's JQL (`labels = provider_quota`) must be overridden to match.
- `jobParams.quotaProbeEveryNTicks` — probe cadence in SM ticks (default 3). The first tick after the park always probes (a misclassification self-corrects immediately).
- `jobParams.quotaProbeCommand` — the cheap provider ping shell command (default: a 1-token chat completion against the fa provider config `FA_PROVIDER_BASE_URL` / `FA_PROVIDER_API_KEY` / `FA_PROVIDER_MODEL`; curl `--fail` keeps the park on any HTTP error). Override for non-fa provider shapes.

A human un-parks immediately by removing the park label from the ticket — the probe rule stops matching and no further probes fire.

{"content":"# quota park probe

Bounded self-lift for the gh-1087 provider-quota park: runs locally on every SM tick against tickets carrying the park label (default `provider_quota`) and fires one cheap provider ping only when the recorded probe count hits the `jobParams.quotaProbeEveryNTicks` cadence (default 3 ticks).

Probe success means the quota window has reset or the provider was reconfigured — the handler removes the park label, clears the development/rework dispatch trigger labels, moves the ticket back to Ready For Development and posts an un-park comment, so the normal dispatch lanes resume on the next tick. Probe failure keeps the park and posts a one-line `quota-probe: <n>` marker comment that doubles as the durable counter for the next tick's cadence decision.

## Parameters

- `jobParams.quotaParkLabel` — park label name to watch and remove (default `provider_quota`). When overridden, the SM rule's JQL (`labels = provider_quota`) must be overridden to match.
- `jobParams.quotaProbeEveryNTicks` — probe cadence in SM ticks (default 3). The first tick after the park always probes (a misclassification self-corrects immediately).
- `jobParams.quotaProbeCommand` — the cheap provider ping shell command (default: a 1-token chat completion against the fa provider config `FA_PROVIDER_BASE_URL` / `FA_PROVIDER_API_KEY` / `FA_PROVIDER_MODEL`; curl `--fail` keeps the park on any HTTP error). Override for non-fa provider shapes.

A human un-parks immediately by removing the park label from the ticket — the probe rule stops matching and no further probes fire.

{"content":"# quota park probe

Bounded self-lift for the gh-1087 provider-quota park: runs locally on every SM tick against tickets carrying the park label (default `provider_quota`) and fires one cheap provider ping only when the recorded probe count hits the `jobParams.quotaProbeEveryNTicks` cadence (default 3 ticks).

Probe success means the quota window has reset or the provider was reconfigured — the handler removes the park label, clears the development/rework dispatch trigger labels, moves the ticket back to Ready For Development and posts an un-park comment, so the normal dispatch lanes resume on the next tick. Probe failure keeps the park and posts a one-line `quota-probe: <n>` marker comment that doubles as the durable counter for the next tick's cadence decision.

## Parameters

- `jobParams.quotaParkLabel` — park label name to watch and remove (default `provider_quota`). When overridden, the SM rule's JQL (`labels = provider_quota`) must be overridden to match.
- `jobParams.quotaProbeEveryNTicks` — probe cadence in SM ticks (default 3). The first tick after the park always probes (a misclassification self-corrects immediately).
- `jobParams.quotaProbeCommand` — the cheap provider ping shell command (default: a 1-token chat completion against the fa provider config `FA_PROVIDER_BASE_URL` / `FA_PROVIDER_API_KEY` / `FA_PROVIDER_MODEL`; curl `--fail` keeps the park on any HTTP error). Override for non-fa provider shapes.

A human un-parks immediately by removing the park label from the ticket — the probe rule stops matching and no further probes fire.

{"content":"# quota park probe

Bounded self-lift for the gh-1087 provider-quota park: runs locally on every SM tick against tickets carrying the park label (default `provider_quota`) and fires one cheap provider ping only when the recorded probe count hits the `jobParams.quotaProbeEveryNTicks` cadence (default 3 ticks).

Probe success means the quota window has reset or the provider was reconfigured — the handler removes the park label, clears the development/rework dispatch trigger labels, moves the ticket back to Ready For Development and posts an un-park comment, so the normal dispatch lanes resume on the next tick. Probe failure keeps the park and posts a one-line `quota-probe: <n>` marker comment that doubles as the durable counter for the next tick's cadence decision.

## Parameters

- `jobParams.quotaParkLabel` — park label name to watch and remove (default `provider_quota`). When overridden, the SM rule's JQL (`labels = provider_quota`) must be overridden to match.
- `jobParams.quotaProbeEveryNTicks` — probe cadence in SM ticks (default 3). The first tick after the park always probes (a misclassification self-corrects immediately).
- `jobParams.quotaProbeCommand` — the cheap provider ping shell command (default: a 1-token chat completion against the fa provider config `FA_PROVIDER_BASE_URL` / `FA_PROVIDER_API_KEY` / `FA_PROVIDER_MODEL`; curl `--fail` keeps the park on any HTTP error). Override for non-fa provider shapes.

A human un-parks immediately by removing the park label from the ticket — the probe rule stops matching and no further probes fire.

Recovery job: unsticks a Story/Bug ticket left in the configured "actively being developed" status (statuses.IN_DEVELOPMENT) after a failed or interrupted development/rework run.

_Human doc: [`agents/docs/agents/recover_stuck_development.md`](agents/docs/agents/recover_stuck_development.md)_

## Attributes

| Attribute | Value |
|---|---|
| Job | `Teammate` |
| Config | `recover_stuck_development.json` |
| ContextId | `recover_stuck_development` |
| outputType | `none` |

{"content":"# quota park probe

Bounded self-lift for the gh-1087 provider-quota park: runs locally on every SM tick against tickets carrying the park label (default `provider_quota`) and fires one cheap provider ping only when the recorded probe count hits the `jobParams.quotaProbeEveryNTicks` cadence (default 3 ticks).

Probe success means the quota window has reset or the provider was reconfigured — the handler removes the park label, clears the development/rework dispatch trigger labels, moves the ticket back to Ready For Development and posts an un-park comment, so the normal dispatch lanes resume on the next tick. Probe failure keeps the park and posts a one-line `quota-probe: <n>` marker comment that doubles as the durable counter for the next tick's cadence decision.

## Parameters

- `jobParams.quotaParkLabel` — park label name to watch and remove (default `provider_quota`). When overridden, the SM rule's JQL (`labels = provider_quota`) must be overridden to match.
- `jobParams.quotaProbeEveryNTicks` — probe cadence in SM ticks (default 3). The first tick after the park always probes (a misclassification self-corrects immediately).
- `jobParams.quotaProbeCommand` — the cheap provider ping shell command (default: a 1-token chat completion against the fa provider config `FA_PROVIDER_BASE_URL` / `FA_PROVIDER_API_KEY` / `FA_PROVIDER_MODEL`; curl `--fail` keeps the park on any HTTP error). Override for non-fa provider shapes.

A human un-parks immediately by removing the park label from the ticket — the probe rule stops matching and no further probes fire.

{"content":"# quota park probe

Bounded self-lift for the gh-1087 provider-quota park: runs locally on every SM tick against tickets carrying the park label (default `provider_quota`) and fires one cheap provider ping only when the recorded probe count hits the `jobParams.quotaProbeEveryNTicks` cadence (default 3 ticks).

Probe success means the quota window has reset or the provider was reconfigured — the handler removes the park label, clears the development/rework dispatch trigger labels, moves the ticket back to Ready For Development and posts an un-park comment, so the normal dispatch lanes resume on the next tick. Probe failure keeps the park and posts a one-line `quota-probe: <n>` marker comment that doubles as the durable counter for the next tick's cadence decision.

## Parameters

- `jobParams.quotaParkLabel` — park label name to watch and remove (default `provider_quota`). When overridden, the SM rule's JQL (`labels = provider_quota`) must be overridden to match.
- `jobParams.quotaProbeEveryNTicks` — probe cadence in SM ticks (default 3). The first tick after the park always probes (a misclassification self-corrects immediately).
- `jobParams.quotaProbeCommand` — the cheap provider ping shell command (default: a 1-token chat completion against the fa provider config `FA_PROVIDER_BASE_URL` / `FA_PROVIDER_API_KEY` / `FA_PROVIDER_MODEL`; curl `--fail` keeps the park on any HTTP error). Override for non-fa provider shapes.

A human un-parks immediately by removing the park label from the ticket — the probe rule stops matching and no further probes fire.

{"content":"# quota park probe

Bounded self-lift for the gh-1087 provider-quota park: runs locally on every SM tick against tickets carrying the park label (default `provider_quota`) and fires one cheap provider ping only when the recorded probe count hits the `jobParams.quotaProbeEveryNTicks` cadence (default 3 ticks).

Probe success means the quota window has reset or the provider was reconfigured — the handler removes the park label, clears the development/rework dispatch trigger labels, moves the ticket back to Ready For Development and posts an un-park comment, so the normal dispatch lanes resume on the next tick. Probe failure keeps the park and posts a one-line `quota-probe: <n>` marker comment that doubles as the durable counter for the next tick's cadence decision.

## Parameters

- `jobParams.quotaParkLabel` — park label name to watch and remove (default `provider_quota`). When overridden, the SM rule's JQL (`labels = provider_quota`) must be overridden to match.
- `jobParams.quotaProbeEveryNTicks` — probe cadence in SM ticks (default 3). The first tick after the park always probes (a misclassification self-corrects immediately).
- `jobParams.quotaProbeCommand` — the cheap provider ping shell command (default: a 1-token chat completion against the fa provider config `FA_PROVIDER_BASE_URL` / `FA_PROVIDER_API_KEY` / `FA_PROVIDER_MODEL`; curl `--fail` keeps the park on any HTTP error). Override for non-fa provider shapes.

A human un-parks immediately by removing the park label from the ticket — the probe rule stops matching and no further probes fire.

{"content":"# quota park probe

Bounded self-lift for the gh-1087 provider-quota park: runs locally on every SM tick against tickets carrying the park label (default `provider_quota`) and fires one cheap provider ping only when the recorded probe count hits the `jobParams.quotaProbeEveryNTicks` cadence (default 3 ticks).

Probe success means the quota window has reset or the provider was reconfigured — the handler removes the park label, clears the development/rework dispatch trigger labels, moves the ticket back to Ready For Development and posts an un-park comment, so the normal dispatch lanes resume on the next tick. Probe failure keeps the park and posts a one-line `quota-probe: <n>` marker comment that doubles as the durable counter for the next tick's cadence decision.

## Parameters

- `jobParams.quotaParkLabel` — park label name to watch and remove (default `provider_quota`). When overridden, the SM rule's JQL (`labels = provider_quota`) must be overridden to match.
- `jobParams.quotaProbeEveryNTicks` — probe cadence in SM ticks (default 3). The first tick after the park always probes (a misclassification self-corrects immediately).
- `jobParams.quotaProbeCommand` — the cheap provider ping shell command (default: a 1-token chat completion against the fa provider config `FA_PROVIDER_BASE_URL` / `FA_PROVIDER_API_KEY` / `FA_PROVIDER_MODEL`; curl `--fail` keeps the park on any HTTP error). Override for non-fa provider shapes.

A human un-parks immediately by removing the park label from the ticket — the probe rule stops matching and no further probes fire.

{"content":"# quota park probe

Bounded self-lift for the gh-1087 provider-quota park: runs locally on every SM tick against tickets carrying the park label (default `provider_quota`) and fires one cheap provider ping only when the recorded probe count hits the `jobParams.quotaProbeEveryNTicks` cadence (default 3 ticks).

Probe success means the quota window has reset or the provider was reconfigured — the handler removes the park label, clears the development/rework dispatch trigger labels, moves the ticket back to Ready For Development and posts an un-park comment, so the normal dispatch lanes resume on the next tick. Probe failure keeps the park and posts a one-line `quota-probe: <n>` marker comment that doubles as the durable counter for the next tick's cadence decision.

## Parameters

- `jobParams.quotaParkLabel` — park label name to watch and remove (default `provider_quota`). When overridden, the SM rule's JQL (`labels = provider_quota`) must be overridden to match.
- `jobParams.quotaProbeEveryNTicks` — probe cadence in SM ticks (default 3). The first tick after the park always probes (a misclassification self-corrects immediately).
- `jobParams.quotaProbeCommand` — the cheap provider ping shell command (default: a 1-token chat completion against the fa provider config `FA_PROVIDER_BASE_URL` / `FA_PROVIDER_API_KEY` / `FA_PROVIDER_MODEL`; curl `--fail` keeps the park on any HTTP error). Override for non-fa provider shapes.

A human un-parks immediately by removing the park label from the ticket — the probe rule stops matching and no further probes fire.

{"content":"# quota park probe

Bounded self-lift for the gh-1087 provider-quota park: runs locally on every SM tick against tickets carrying the park label (default `provider_quota`) and fires one cheap provider ping only when the recorded probe count hits the `jobParams.quotaProbeEveryNTicks` cadence (default 3 ticks).

Probe success means the quota window has reset or the provider was reconfigured — the handler removes the park label, clears the development/rework dispatch trigger labels, moves the ticket back to Ready For Development and posts an un-park comment, so the normal dispatch lanes resume on the next tick. Probe failure keeps the park and posts a one-line `quota-probe: <n>` marker comment that doubles as the durable counter for the next tick's cadence decision.

## Parameters

- `jobParams.quotaParkLabel` — park label name to watch and remove (default `provider_quota`). When overridden, the SM rule's JQL (`labels = provider_quota`) must be overridden to match.
- `jobParams.quotaProbeEveryNTicks` — probe cadence in SM ticks (default 3). The first tick after the park always probes (a misclassification self-corrects immediately).
- `jobParams.quotaProbeCommand` — the cheap provider ping shell command (default: a 1-token chat completion against the fa provider config `FA_PROVIDER_BASE_URL` / `FA_PROVIDER_API_KEY` / `FA_PROVIDER_MODEL`; curl `--fail` keeps the park on any HTTP error). Override for non-fa provider shapes.

A human un-parks immediately by removing the park label from the ticket — the probe rule stops matching and no further probes fire.

{"content":"# quota park probe

Bounded self-lift for the gh-1087 provider-quota park: runs locally on every SM tick against tickets carrying the park label (default `provider_quota`) and fires one cheap provider ping only when the recorded probe count hits the `jobParams.quotaProbeEveryNTicks` cadence (default 3 ticks).

Probe success means the quota window has reset or the provider was reconfigured — the handler removes the park label, clears the development/rework dispatch trigger labels, moves the ticket back to Ready For Development and posts an un-park comment, so the normal dispatch lanes resume on the next tick. Probe failure keeps the park and posts a one-line `quota-probe: <n>` marker comment that doubles as the durable counter for the next tick's cadence decision.

## Parameters

- `jobParams.quotaParkLabel` — park label name to watch and remove (default `provider_quota`). When overridden, the SM rule's JQL (`labels = provider_quota`) must be overridden to match.
- `jobParams.quotaProbeEveryNTicks` — probe cadence in SM ticks (default 3). The first tick after the park always probes (a misclassification self-corrects immediately).
- `jobParams.quotaProbeCommand` — the cheap provider ping shell command (default: a 1-token chat completion against the fa provider config `FA_PROVIDER_BASE_URL` / `FA_PROVIDER_API_KEY` / `FA_PROVIDER_MODEL`; curl `--fail` keeps the park on any HTTP error). Override for non-fa provider shapes.

A human un-parks immediately by removing the park label from the ticket — the probe rule stops matching and no further probes fire.

{"content":"# quota park probe

Bounded self-lift for the gh-1087 provider-quota park: runs locally on every SM tick against tickets carrying the park label (default `provider_quota`) and fires one cheap provider ping only when the recorded probe count hits the `jobParams.quotaProbeEveryNTicks` cadence (default 3 ticks).

Probe success means the quota window has reset or the provider was reconfigured — the handler removes the park label, clears the development/rework dispatch trigger labels, moves the ticket back to Ready For Development and posts an un-park comment, so the normal dispatch lanes resume on the next tick. Probe failure keeps the park and posts a one-line `quota-probe: <n>` marker comment that doubles as the durable counter for the next tick's cadence decision.

## Parameters

- `jobParams.quotaParkLabel` — park label name to watch and remove (default `provider_quota`). When overridden, the SM rule's JQL (`labels = provider_quota`) must be overridden to match.
- `jobParams.quotaProbeEveryNTicks` — probe cadence in SM ticks (default 3). The first tick after the park always probes (a misclassification self-corrects immediately).
- `jobParams.quotaProbeCommand` — the cheap provider ping shell command (default: a 1-token chat completion against the fa provider config `FA_PROVIDER_BASE_URL` / `FA_PROVIDER_API_KEY` / `FA_PROVIDER_MODEL`; curl `--fail` keeps the park on any HTTP error). Override for non-fa provider shapes.

A human un-parks immediately by removing the park label from the ticket — the probe rule stops matching and no further probes fire.

{"content":"# quota park probe

Bounded self-lift for the gh-1087 provider-quota park: runs locally on every SM tick against tickets carrying the park label (default `provider_quota`) and fires one cheap provider ping only when the recorded probe count hits the `jobParams.quotaProbeEveryNTicks` cadence (default 3 ticks).

Probe success means the quota window has reset or the provider was reconfigured — the handler removes the park label, clears the development/rework dispatch trigger labels, moves the ticket back to Ready For Development and posts an un-park comment, so the normal dispatch lanes resume on the next tick. Probe failure keeps the park and posts a one-line `quota-probe: <n>` marker comment that doubles as the durable counter for the next tick's cadence decision.

## Parameters

- `jobParams.quotaParkLabel` — park label name to watch and remove (default `provider_quota`). When overridden, the SM rule's JQL (`labels = provider_quota`) must be overridden to match.
- `jobParams.quotaProbeEveryNTicks` — probe cadence in SM ticks (default 3). The first tick after the park always probes (a misclassification self-corrects immediately).
- `jobParams.quotaProbeCommand` — the cheap provider ping shell command (default: a 1-token chat completion against the fa provider config `FA_PROVIDER_BASE_URL` / `FA_PROVIDER_API_KEY` / `FA_PROVIDER_MODEL`; curl `--fail` keeps the park on any HTTP error). Override for non-fa provider shapes.

A human un-parks immediately by removing the park label from the ticket — the probe rule stops matching and no further probes fire.

{"content":"# quota park probe

Bounded self-lift for the gh-1087 provider-quota park: runs locally on every SM tick against tickets carrying the park label (default `provider_quota`) and fires one cheap provider ping only when the recorded probe count hits the `jobParams.quotaProbeEveryNTicks` cadence (default 3 ticks).

Probe success means the quota window has reset or the provider was reconfigured — the handler removes the park label, clears the development/rework dispatch trigger labels, moves the ticket back to Ready For Development and posts an un-park comment, so the normal dispatch lanes resume on the next tick. Probe failure keeps the park and posts a one-line `quota-probe: <n>` marker comment that doubles as the durable counter for the next tick's cadence decision.

## Parameters

- `jobParams.quotaParkLabel` — park label name to watch and remove (default `provider_quota`). When overridden, the SM rule's JQL (`labels = provider_quota`) must be overridden to match.
- `jobParams.quotaProbeEveryNTicks` — probe cadence in SM ticks (default 3). The first tick after the park always probes (a misclassification self-corrects immediately).
- `jobParams.quotaProbeCommand` — the cheap provider ping shell command (default: a 1-token chat completion against the fa provider config `FA_PROVIDER_BASE_URL` / `FA_PROVIDER_API_KEY` / `FA_PROVIDER_MODEL`; curl `--fail` keeps the park on any HTTP error). Override for non-fa provider shapes.

A human un-parks immediately by removing the park label from the ticket — the probe rule stops matching and no further probes fire.

{"content":"# quota park probe

Bounded self-lift for the gh-1087 provider-quota park: runs locally on every SM tick against tickets carrying the park label (default `provider_quota`) and fires one cheap provider ping only when the recorded probe count hits the `jobParams.quotaProbeEveryNTicks` cadence (default 3 ticks).

Probe success means the quota window has reset or the provider was reconfigured — the handler removes the park label, clears the development/rework dispatch trigger labels, moves the ticket back to Ready For Development and posts an un-park comment, so the normal dispatch lanes resume on the next tick. Probe failure keeps the park and posts a one-line `quota-probe: <n>` marker comment that doubles as the durable counter for the next tick's cadence decision.

## Parameters

- `jobParams.quotaParkLabel` — park label name to watch and remove (default `provider_quota`). When overridden, the SM rule's JQL (`labels = provider_quota`) must be overridden to match.
- `jobParams.quotaProbeEveryNTicks` — probe cadence in SM ticks (default 3). The first tick after the park always probes (a misclassification self-corrects immediately).
- `jobParams.quotaProbeCommand` — the cheap provider ping shell command (default: a 1-token chat completion against the fa provider config `FA_PROVIDER_BASE_URL` / `FA_PROVIDER_API_KEY` / `FA_PROVIDER_MODEL`; curl `--fail` keeps the park on any HTTP error). Override for non-fa provider shapes.

{"content":"# quota park probe

Bounded self-lift for the gh-1087 provider-quota park: runs locally on every SM tick against tickets carrying the park label (default `provider_quota`) and fires one cheap provider ping only when the recorded probe count hits the `jobParams.quotaProbeEveryNTicks` cadence (default 3 ticks).

Probe success means the quota window has reset or the provider was reconfigured — the handler removes the park label, clears the development/rework dispatch trigger labels, moves the ticket back to Ready For Development and posts an un-park comment, so the normal dispatch lanes resume on the next tick. Probe failure keeps the park and posts a one-line `quota-probe: <n>` marker comment that doubles as the durable counter for the next tick's cadence decision.

## Parameters

- `jobParams.quotaParkLabel` — park label name to watch and remove (default `provider_quota`). When overridden, the SM rule's JQL (`labels = provider_quota`) must be overridden to match.
- `jobParams.quotaProbeEveryNTicks` — probe cadence in SM ticks (default 3). The first tick after the park always probes (a misclassification self-corrects immediately).
- `jobParams.quotaProbeCommand` — the cheap provider ping shell command (default: a 1-token chat completion against the fa provider config `FA_PROVIDER_BASE_URL` / `FA_PROVIDER_API_KEY` / `FA_PROVIDER_MODEL`; curl `--fail` keeps the park on any HTTP error). Override for non-fa provider shapes.

A human un-parks immediately by removing the park label from the ticket — the probe rule stops matching and no further probes fire.

{"content":"# quota park probe

Bounded self-lift for the gh-1087 provider-quota park: runs locally on every SM tick against tickets carrying the park label (default `provider_quota`) and fires one cheap provider ping only when the recorded probe count hits the `jobParams.quotaProbeEveryNTicks` cadence (default 3 ticks).

Probe success means the quota window has reset or the provider was reconfigured — the handler removes the park label, clears the development/rework dispatch trigger labels, moves the ticket back to Ready For Development and posts an un-park comment, so the normal dispatch lanes resume on the next tick. Probe failure keeps the park and posts a one-line `quota-probe: <n>` marker comment that doubles as the durable counter for the next tick's cadence decision.

## Parameters

- `jobParams.quotaParkLabel` — park label name to watch and remove (default `provider_quota`). When overridden, the SM rule's JQL (`labels = provider_quota`) must be overridden to match.
- `jobParams.quotaProbeEveryNTicks` — probe cadence in SM ticks (default 3). The first tick after the park always probes (a misclassification self-corrects immediately).
- `jobParams.quotaProbeCommand` — the cheap provider ping shell command (default: a 1-token chat completion against the fa provider config `FA_PROVIDER_BASE_URL` / `FA_PROVIDER_API_KEY` / `FA_PROVIDER_MODEL`; curl `--fail` keeps the park on any HTTP error). Override for non-fa provider shapes.

A human un-parks immediately by removing the park label from the ticket — the probe rule stops matching and no further probes fire.

### What changed Added a provider-quota circuit-breaker (gh-1087): a hard quota failure (HTTP 403 usage-limit body or a "Provider chain exhausted" tail after quota responses) now **parks** the ticket's lane — park label + reason comment, no Ready For Development reset — instead of the gh-742 per-tick retry burn. Transient interruptions (429, timeouts) keep the classic reset exactly. ### Key decisions - New pure module `js/common/quotaCircuitBreaker.js`: classifier, park-label/probe-cadence config readers (`jobParams.quotaParkLabel` / `quotaProbeEveryNTicks` / `quotaProbeCommand`), probe marker math, SM dispatch-lane exclusion predicate, comment builders. - Quota gate runs **first** in both legs' interrupted/missing-response paths (before the fatal-env throw and the bounded resume) — a resume against an exhausted chain is a guaranteed 403 burn. Park labels the ticket and the open PR (if any), does not move status, and fails the run with a marked `quotaPark` error (same dead-letter contract as gh-742). - `smAgent.js` excludes parked tickets from every dispatch lane except `rule.quotaParkProbe` rules; new local-execution job `quota_park_probe.json` / `js/quotaParkProbe.js` + `sm.json` rule probes with one cheap provider ping per N ticks (default fa chat-completion ping via curl `--fail`) and un-parks on success (label + trigger labels removed, ticket back to Ready For Development). Human label removal un-parks immediately. - `docs/agents/quota_park_probe.md` + generated docs added (agentDocs coverage gate). ### How to verify ```bash dmtools run js/unit-tests/run_quotaCircuitBreaker.json # 23 tests: UT-1 fixtures, cadence, exclusion, probe un-park dmtools run js/unit-tests/run_all.json # full suite: 4600 passed, 0 failed (incl. UT-2 park paths + unchanged gh-742 REG-1) ```
Flow diagram ```mermaid flowchart TD FAIL[Leg failure text] --> CLS{classifyFailure} CLS -->|quota_exhausted| PARK[Park: label + comment
no status reset, run RED] CLS -->|transient / unknown| RST[gh-742 reset + retry
unchanged] PARK --> SM[SM dispatch skips
provider_quota lanes] SM --> PROBE{probe due?
1 ping per N ticks} PROBE -->|success| UNPARK[Remove label + trigger labels
→ Ready For Development] PROBE -->|failed| PARK ```

Transient interruptions (429, timeouts) keep the classic reset exactly. ### Key decisions - New pure module `js/common/quotaCircuitBreaker.js`: classifier, park-label/probe-cadence config readers (`jobParams.quotaParkLabel` / `quotaProbeEveryNTicks` / `quotaProbeCommand`), probe marker math, SM dispatch-lane exclusion predicate, comment builders. - Quota gate runs **first** in both legs' interrupted/missing-response paths (before the fatal-env throw and the bounded resume) — a resume against an exhausted chain is a guaranteed 403 burn. Park labels the ticket and the open PR (if any), does not move status, and fails the run with a marked `quotaPark` error (same dead-letter contract as gh-742). - `smAgent.js` excludes parked tickets from every dispatch lane except `rule.quotaParkProbe` rules; new local-execution job `quota_park_probe.json` / `js/quotaParkProbe.js` + `sm.json` rule probes with one cheap provider ping per N ticks (default fa chat-completion ping via curl `--fail`) and un-parks on success (label + trigger labels removed, ticket back to Ready For Development). Human label removal un-parks immediately. - `docs/agents/quota_park_probe.md` + generated docs added (agentDocs coverage gate). ### How to verify ```bash dmtools run js/unit-tests/run_quotaCircuitBreaker.json # 23 tests: UT-1 fixtures, cadence, exclusion, probe un-park dmtools run js/unit-tests/run_all.json # full suite: 4600 passed, 0 failed (incl. UT-2 park paths + unchanged gh-742 REG-1) ```
Flow diagram ```mermaid flowchart TD FAIL[Leg failure text] --> CLS{classifyFailure} CLS -->|quota_exhausted| PARK[Park: label + comment
no status reset, run RED] CLS -->|transient / unknown| RST[gh-742 reset + retry
unchanged] PARK --> SM[SM dispatch skips
provider_quota lanes] SM --> PROBE{probe due?
1 ping per N ticks} PROBE -->|success| UNPARK[Remove label + trigger labels
→ Ready For Development] PROBE -->|failed| PARK ```
